name: Additive Waveform
desc: An oscilloscope of Fourier synthesis where stacked lanes of faint spectral sine harmonics (low=red to high=violet) sum into one bright gold composite that perpetually morphs between sawtooth, square and organic timbres as harmonic amplitudes and phases drift.

harmonics.doc: number of summed sine harmonics (richer/sharper edges)

scale.doc: horizontal zoom = cycles across the width
